offline_contract_scope.measured: Pass/fail/skip, complete command wall time and file hashes in each runner record. Byte identity, restart/delete behavior, snapshot identity, budget and page navigation checked by assertions.
offline_contract_scope.unavailable: Per-request ingestion/answer/first-delta latency, index size and fact coverage were not instrumented in mocked suites; total command duration is not response latency.
offline_contract_scope.not_applicable: Live semantic retrieval/answer quality, provider cost and production throughput; mocked providers cannot establish them.

frontend-1.reason: Runner initially summed Test Files and Tests; log is authoritative.

frontend-2.reason: Same pre-fix runner; raw artifacts kept unchanged.

local-1.reason: Script output is not a pytest summary.

comparison.baseline: Stage 1 had no PDF upload/retrieval/viewer, so a live PDF before/after quality score is unavailable. TXT/Markdown regression suites retained. Frozen Apple extraction and query reused for contract checks. No general RAG improvement claimed.
comparison.failure_review: Codex reviewed failed SSE test framing, added schema/CLI expectations and old TXT recovery semantics; fixed them. Native browser PDF popup stayed blank; replaced it with bundled PDF.js and verified render and page navigation. Build-2 used obsolete positional getDocument; corrected to object argument. All original logs retained.
